name: external-standard-mode-regression
description: Regression: a standard-mode review of the same change must not perform backend discovery or any external review.
prompt: Use `$kk:review-code` to review the staged changes.
trap: The new discovery/clink routing leaks into standard mode.

assertions.text: The actor runs the standard `$kk:review-code` workflow and never calls listmodels, codereview or clink, and states no external backend decision or roster.
The report uses the standard Code Review Summary format (no isolated-mode reviewer/roster line).

The P1 at settings.py:3 (ok:true does not mean applied:true, given provider.py's read-only response) is reported with a profile/checklist label (the python profile is active for the `.py` fixture; the generic label is also acceptable) and REQUEST_CHANGES.
